title: Concept: XML parser with entities enabled (php) — review required
description: In php, LIBXML_NOENT|LIBXML_DTDLOAD switches entity processing on. XXE payloads abuse doctypes to exfiltrate files and scan networks through the parser's authority. The remedy is disabling entities via no entity flags.
applicability: php XML parsing configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: File disclosure and SSRF through malicious XML; HIGH severity.
